newsitem.title: USA: Marathon has 2 successful East Texas wells.
newsitem.headline: Marathon has 2 successful East Texas wells.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said it added two wells to its string of successes in the Cotton Valley Reef trend with the Riley Trust No. 3 in Robertson County and the Poth No. 2 in Leon County, Texas.

The Riley Trust No. 3 encountered reef and tested natural gas at the rate of 10 million cubic feet per day. Marathon is the operator of the well with a 75 percent interest. Broughton Associates Joint Venture owns the remaining 25 percent.
The Poth No. 2 well, which flowed 31.7 million cubic feet daily, is within the largest reef accumulation encountered by Marathon to date.
The company said it has a 100 percent interest in the well.
The company said gross production from 10 wells in which it holds interest now totals almost 140 million cubic feet daily.
Marathon Oil is part of the USX-Marathon Group, a unit of USX Corp.((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
